commit.message: change lower boundary for MaxMetaspaceSize from 4K to 128K; move globals.hpp comment from MaxMetaspaceSize to MetaspaceSize; remove testing a too small MaxMetaspaceSize from test/hotspot/jtreg/gc/metaspace/TestMetaspaceSizeFlags.java since runtime/Metaspace/MaxMetaspaceSizeTest.java already does that; test/hotspot/jtreg/runtime/Metaspace/MaxMetaspaceSizeTest.java should use 128K instead of 4K for its too small MaxMetaspaceSize test; remove stale comment about -XX:MaxMetaspaceSize=100k from test/hotspot/jtreg/vmTestbase/metaspace/shrink_grow/ShrinkGrowTest/ShrinkGrowTest.java
pre-cog tool identified more missing uses of FLAG_SET_ERGO.

Changes for CR3: Restore simpler version of MaxMetaspaceSizeConstraintFunc; refactor the test to be more flexible in specifying flag values in different orders and counts; rename baseline test cases to be more clear with fewer params: testMaxMetaspaceSizeEQMetaspaceSize -> testEQFlagValues, testMaxMetaspaceSizeLTMetaspaceSize -> testMaxHalfFlagValues, testMaxMetaspaceSizeGTMetaspaceSize -> testMax2XFlagValues; the baseline test cases also need to test both options in either order; move new test cases for 8395825 after baseline test cases; drop mention of 8395825 in new comments; for negative cases, check for VM termination indicators and exit codes; for positive cases, check for lack of VM termination indicators and exit codes.

Changes for CR2: Drop MaxMetaspaceSizeConstraintFunc, MaxMetaspaceSize flag only needs the range check; drop global defaultMetaspaceSize variable; Metaspace::ergo_initialize()'s adjustment of MetaspaceSize should use FLAG_SET_ERGO; clarify test comments to document outcomes and not implementation details.
Add test cases and make fixes based on pre-cog review.
8395825: MetaspaceSize and MaxMetaspaceSize flags should be checked "AtParse" instead of "AfterErgo"
